📉 What moved today, Friday 13 November

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.5% lower at 104,487. Banks and insurers led the fall, down 1.2%, while mining shares were flat.

💱 The rand weakened again, by about 1% to around R16.95 to the dollar.

🛢️ Brent oil rose 0.5% to about $96.27, and gold slipped 0.2% to about $3,868.

What it means for you: a weaker rand and oil near $96 can make fuel and imported goods dearer.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
